article.title: Adobe把CX Enterprise Coworker接入多個AI平台，部分接入仍待推出
article.title_en: Adobe brings CX Enterprise Coworker to AI platforms, with more integrations planned
article.summary: Adobe於11月4日宣布，企業可在ChatGPT、Claude等平台使用其客戶體驗協作能力。
article.summary_en: Adobe’s November 4 announcement brings customer-experience workflows into platforms including ChatGPT and Claude.
highlights: 已列為可用的接入包括Databricks Genie、Gemini for business及Microsoft Copilot。
Amazon Quick、IBM及Snowflake接入仍屬後續安排。
highlights_en: Databricks Genie, Gemini for business and Microsoft Copilot are also listed as available.
Amazon Quick, IBM and Snowflake availability is still planned.
article.why: 使用不同AI助手的行銷團隊，可評估能否沿用同一套客戶資料與活動流程。
article.why_en: Teams using different AI assistants can assess whether customer context and campaign workflows can stay connected.
article.next_step: 先核對帳戶資格、資料權限及可執行動作，再選一條低風險流程試行。
article.next_step_en: Check eligibility, data permissions and action scope before testing one low-risk workflow.
article.detail: CX Enterprise Coworker處理客戶體驗的規劃、分析及流程協調，公告強調執行仍有人員監督。新連接器採用MCP，即讓AI工具接入外部系統的通用協定，涵蓋廣告及企業資料工具。這是接入範圍擴展，並非所有帳戶自動取得全部功能；不同平台的資格、操作及費用需個別核對。公告沒有證明接入後必然提升轉換，本報亦未實測。
article.detail_en: The system coordinates experience planning, analysis and workflows with human oversight. New connectors use MCP, a protocol for connecting AI tools with external systems. This expands integration routes; account eligibility, permissions and charges still need checking. No conversion gains are established.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
